item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
[Image: A large triangle. The left angle is 45 degrees and the top angle is 65 degrees. A line is drawn on the side between the 45 and 64 degree angle to form two smaller triangles—one adjacent to the larger triangle, and one contained within the larger triangle. The right most angle of the triangle adjacent to the larger triangle has an angle of 30 degrees. The smaller triangle contained within the bigger triangle has an angle x that is formed by the right side of the triangle and the drawn line.]

In the figure above, what is the value of x?
item.figure_description: A geometric figure featuring intersecting lines and triangles. A triangle has a horizontal base, a left side with an interior angle of 45° at the bottom-left vertex, and an interior angle of 65° at the top vertex. A line segment extends from the top vertex down to the base. A second line segment extends from a point on the left side of the triangle down and to the right, crossing the first line segment and ending at the rightmost endpoint of the extended horizontal base, where the interior angle is labeled 30°. Near the top vertex, a smaller triangle is bounded by the upper part of the left side, the upper part of the segment from the top vertex, and the crossing segment; the interior angle at the intersection of the two segments is marked with an arc and labeled x.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

guessing.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's guessing (lower asymptote) parameter c: the probability that a student of very low ability answers it correctly, such as by guessing among the options? Choose the value closest to it.
